subject.title: fix(ci): bound opengrep install script downloads

question: Should this security-labeled PR land as narrow timeout and partial-stream hardening, or must it also replace remote installer execution with a shared hash-verified binary installation path?
rationale: The patch safely addresses the reported availability problem, but repository automation cannot choose whether the security boundary for these scanner workflows also requires independent artifact verification and centralization.

options.title: Accept narrow hardening
options.body: Require real success and stalled-transfer proof, then land the bounded temporary-file approach without expanding this PR.

options.title: Require verified binary install
options.body: Hold the PR until both workflows use a shared installer that downloads the v1.22.0 release asset and verifies its published SHA-256 before execution.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow hardening
recommendation.body: Require real success and stalled-transfer proof, then land the bounded temporary-file approach without expanding this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the OpenGrep workflow surface and are the strongest history-backed owner for its installation boundary.
